title: Three witnesses held at gunpoint and given 'anthrax boosters'

tellings.quote: All three of these men directly after their encounters were given what they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters.

plain: Three men in the US military who had encounters with unexplained objects were held at gunpoint, the story goes, and right afterwards were given shots they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this on the show without naming his source, and he brings up a man named Jonathan Wagant in connection with it. If it were true, it would suggest that the military treated these witnesses as possibly exposed to something and kept the real reason from them.
